finding: Original approval is exact-byte locked and cannot apply to revised files
risk: Revised package could falsely appear executable
revision_disposition: Mark all revised control documents pending exact-byte Founder reapproval; add reapproval record

finding: Original directive labels pre-reconciliation head as Source Audit Head and omits approved reconciled/custody identities
risk: Execution may anchor to the wrong commit
revision_disposition: Separate original audit head, approved head, merge, custody head/merge, review-time head, and dynamic implementation baseline

finding: Document signature is governed in text but absent from declared workflow list and tests
risk: Document actions may escape the central guard
revision_disposition: Add DOCUMENT_SIGNATURE as the eighth workflow and add route/version/replay tests

finding: At least one guardian can be interpreted as sufficient for a thread containing multiple minors
risk: One minor may lack guardian coverage
revision_disposition: Require qualifying access-capable guardian coverage for each minor

finding: Last-guardian protection can be read to block lawful relationship revocation
risk: Unsafe or disputed authority could be trapped active
revision_disposition: Allow authorized revoke/suspend; block future workflows; keep participant-removal protection separate

finding: Precise relationship reason codes are required but external disclosure rules are not operationally separated
risk: API responses may reveal custody/dispute/minor facts
revision_disposition: Separate internal audit codes from disclosure-safe public error codes

risk: Revocation or removal may race an allowed write
revision_disposition: Require transaction/conditional version/commit-time revalidation and concurrency tests

finding: Consent model lacks subject/transaction scope and explicit grantor-authority validation
risk: Generic or replayed consent may authorize unrelated actions
revision_disposition: Add scope_reference, version, effective window, grantor authority, supersession, and duplicate protection

finding: Active same-barn relationship is not enough to represent domain-limited or restricted authority
revision_disposition: Add workflow authority scopes and restriction/conflict fail-closed rules

finding: No-backfill rule does not explicitly define missing legacy evidence
risk: Existing records may be silently grandfathered
revision_disposition: Define missing authority/consent as unresolved and blocked; no silent conversion

risk: Off-by-one or stale age classification may persist
revision_disposition: Require decision-time classification, testable date source, birthday tests, and cache boundary

finding: Emergency or operational exceptions are not addressed
revision_disposition: Explicitly prohibit implicit override absent separate approved authority

finding: Blanket frontend/src/** path authorization is overbroad
risk: Unrelated UI changes can enter the PR
revision_disposition: Replace with known files plus pre-inventoried exact-path additions

finding: Payment exception language depends on an unspecified approved billing model
risk: Minor obligations may be allowed under ambiguous authority
revision_disposition: Default deny unless exact existing approved authority is evidenced

finding: Audit contents are addressed but sink/access/telemetry boundary is incomplete
risk: Sensitive facts may be copied to new telemetry
revision_disposition: Require existing audit sink, no new external telemetry, disclosure minimization

finding: Immediate revocation is stated but cache invalidation/versioning is not required
revision_disposition: Require request-scoped or invalidation/version-safe cache and tests

finding: Mixed-version and partial rollback behavior is not fully bounded
risk: Old route can bypass new guard during rollback
revision_disposition: Require no mixed-version bypass; suspend workflow if safe rollback unavailable
